# Promptroom

> Create a template from a chat or example, then open it in Promptroom for review and saving.

## Ask an AI to make a template

Give your AI this guide and a worked example, chat, or set of instructions. For example:

> Turn the attached chat into a reusable Promptroom template. Keep my channel's standing instructions and links in the template. Make the transcript a variable. Return a Promptroom review link using this guide.

## Create a template link

1. **Draft.** Put recurring rules, tone, channel links, and visual style in the body. Use `{{name}}` only for inputs the user needs to supply on every run. For a description, use `{{transcript}}`. For a thumbnail, use `{{episode_brief}}`. Create separate templates for channels with different standing instructions. Check that each variable name matches `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*`.
2. **Package.** Create a snapshot using the shape below. Check that the title and body are nonblank. Use an empty string if the description is optional. Include only the reusable instructions and placeholders. Keep source chats, completed inputs, and secrets out of the snapshot because anyone with the link can read it.
3. **Encode.** Use the guide's absolute URL and the snapshot in the JavaScript below. Check that the complete URL is at most 8,000 characters and that decoding the part after `#share=` yields the original JSON. If the link is too long or you cannot verify the encoding, use the JSON file fallback.
4. **Deliver.** Return the review link or JSON file. Tell the user to review the temporary template and choose **Save a copy** to keep it in this browser.

## Snapshot and encoding

```json
{
  "format": "promptroom-share",
  "version": 1,
  "template": {
    "title": "Garden channel video description",
    "description": "Draft a description for a gardening episode.",
    "body": "Write a friendly YouTube description for Garden Notes. Lead with the practical takeaway. Use only facts supported by the transcript. End with an invitation to subscribe. Return only the description.\n\nTranscript:\n{{transcript}}"
  }
}
```

```js
const url = new URL("./", guideUrl);
url.hash = "share=" + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(snapshot));
const reviewLink = url.href;
```

## JSON file fallback

Return the snapshot as a UTF-8 `.json` file up to 256 KiB. The user opens it via **Prompt actions → Share → Open single-prompt JSON**. If file delivery is unavailable or the file is too large, return the title, description, and body for the user to paste into **New prompt**.

## Revise a saved template

Ask the user to select the template, choose **Prompt actions → Share → Download template JSON**, and give you the file. Update its template fields, then follow **Create a template link** to return the revision. **Save a copy** adds a separate template for the revision.

## Transfer a workspace

For a full transfer, direct the user to **Workspace → Preferences → Backups**. Choose **Export backup** in the source browser, then **Import backup**, review the merge, and choose **Apply import** in the destination browser. A workspace backup uses a separate format from a single-template snapshot.

Saved templates and preferences live in the user's browser. For agent-assisted editing, use a template or file the user shares. The public site provides the guide and the template review page.
